description_en: Queries authorized users of a cloud browser group with paging
description_zh: 分页查询云浏览器组的授权用户
name: ListAuthorizedUsers

parameters.help_en: The product type. Set this parameter to `CloudBrowser` when querying authorized users of cloud browsers
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型。查询云浏览器授权用户时填写 `CloudBrowser`，表示云浏览器
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records per page. This parameter is required. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的最大记录数，必填，最大值为 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. This parameter is required. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，必填。从第 1 页开始查询
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The delivery group ID. When querying cloud browsers, set this parameter to the browser group ID.

Specify either this parameter or `AppInstanceGroupSetId`, but not both
parameters.help_zh:
交付组标识。查询云浏览器时填写浏览器组 ID。

与 `AppInstanceGroupSetId` 必须且只能填写一个
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The delivery group set ID.

Specify either this parameter or `AppInstanceGroupId`, but not both. When querying by set, omit `AppId` and `AppInstancePersistentId`
parameters.help_zh:
交付组集合标识。

与 `AppInstanceGroupId` 必须且只能填写一个。按集合查询时，请省略 `AppId` 和 `AppInstancePersistentId`
parameters.name: app_instance_group_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The application ID used to filter authorization relationships.

Set this parameter when querying authorized users of a specific application. This parameter is not required when querying cloud browser groups or delivery group sets
parameters.help_zh:
用于筛选授权关系的应用标识。

查询指定应用的授权用户时填写；查询云浏览器组或交付组集合时无需填写
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: Performs an exact match by authorized username. If this parameter is not specified, results are not filtered by exact username
parameters.help_zh: 按授权用户名精确匹配。省略时不按完整用户名筛选
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: Performs a fuzzy match by text contained in the authorized username
parameters.help_zh: 按授权用户名包含的文本进行模糊匹配
parameters.name: user_id_fuzzy

parameters.help_en:
The persistent session ID used to filter authorization relationships. This parameter applies to delivery groups that use session-based authorization.

This parameter is not required when querying delivery group sets
parameters.help_zh:
用于筛选授权关系的持久会话标识。适用于按会话授权的交付组。

查询交付组集合时无需填写
parameters.name: app_instance_persistent_id

schema.description_en: The paging result of authorized users
schema.description_zh: 授权用户分页查询结果

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page in this request
PageSize.description_zh: 本次请求的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，用于定位本次调用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of authorization records that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的授权记录总数

Users.description_en: The list of authorized users on the current page. An empty list is returned if no authorization records are matched
Users.description_zh: 当前页的授权用户列表。未匹配到授权记录时返回空列表

AccountType.description_en:
The user account type.

`simple`: convenience account.
`ad`: Active Directory (AD) domain account
AccountType.description_zh:
用户账号类型。

`simple`：便捷账号。
`ad`：AD 域账号

AppId.description_en: The application ID specified in this query. This field is not returned if no application filter condition is specified
AppId.description_zh: 本次查询指定的应用标识；未指定应用查询条件时不返回具体应用标识
AppId.title_en:
应用ID。
当AuthMode为App且IsAuthAllApps=false，该字段才有值。
AppId.title_zh:
应用ID。
当AuthMode为App且IsAuthAllApps=false，该字段才有值。

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The delivery group ID to which the authorization relationship belongs. When querying cloud browsers, this is the browser group ID. When querying by set, this field is the primary delivery group ID of the set
AppInstanceGroupId.description_zh: 授权关系所属的交付组标识；查询云浏览器时为浏览器组 ID。按集合查询时，此字段为集合的主交付组标识

AppInstanceGroupSetId.description_en: The delivery group set ID of this query. This field is returned when querying by set
AppInstanceGroupSetId.description_zh: 本次查询的交付组集合标识。按集合查询时返回

AppInstancePersistentIds.description_en: The list of persistent session IDs authorized to the user. This field is returned when the authorization mode is `Session`
AppInstancePersistentIds.description_zh: 用户获授的持久会话标识列表。授权模式为 `Session` 时返回

items.description_en: The persistent session ID authorized to the user
items.description_zh: 用户获授的持久会话标识

AppInstancePersistentIds.title_en:
授权的持久会话ID列表。
当AuthMode为Session时，该字段才有值。
AppInstancePersistentIds.title_zh:
授权的持久会话ID列表。
当AuthMode为Session时，该字段才有值。

AuthMode.description_en:
The authorization mode of the delivery group. Valid values:

`App`: Authorization by application.
`Session`: Authorization by persistent session.
`AppInstanceGroup`: Authorization by delivery group
AuthMode.description_zh:
交付组的授权模式。

`App`：按应用授权。
`Session`：按持久会话授权。
`AppInstanceGroup`：按交付组授权

Email.description_en: The email address of the user. This field may not be returned if the email address is not available
Email.description_zh: 用户邮箱。未获取到用户邮箱信息时可能不返回

IsAuthAllApps.description_en:
Indicates whether the query is not restricted to a specific application. Valid values:

`true`: No application filter condition is specified.
`false`: An application filter condition is specified.

This field is determined by the query conditions and cannot be used alone to determine whether the user is authorized for all applications
IsAuthAllApps.description_zh:
本次查询是否未限定具体应用。

`true`：未指定应用查询条件。
`false`：已指定应用查询条件。

该字段由查询条件决定，不能单独据此判断用户是否获授全部应用

Phone.description_en: The phone number of the user. This field may not be returned if the phone number is not available
Phone.description_zh: 用户手机号码。未获取到用户手机号码时可能不返回
